page.overview:
Who is Charlotte High-Fat?

Charlotte High-Fat is the 20th son and 33rd child of the Charlotte Family and the older twin brother of Tablet. He is also an officer of the Big Mom Pirates.

High-Fat is a very large man, standing taller than Katakuri who is 509 cm tall, making him one of the largest within the Charlotte Family. He has a disproportionate upper-body compared to his lower-body and sports a brown mustache.

He wears a dark blue onesie with light blue polka dots, which covers his hands. His helmet and shoulderplates are yellow and spiked, and he wears dark boots and a pink belt with a yellow buckle.

Not much is known about High-Fat's personality. Having taken part in Big Mom's plan to assassinate the Vinsmoke Family and helped his crew chase after the Straw Hat Pirates, he can be considered very loyal to his family and crew.
